checked.claim: A tokenless participant's side pick is offered once per zone mode and never cleared, so a Logic Dive's later questions count the first pick and no control changes it.
checked.why: offerSidePick is the only caller of requestTrialSide (grep: trial-zones-ui.mjs:456; bridge-asks.mjs:366 defines it); its key is mode|openedAt, and it returns when zone.picks already holds the student. phase() spreads the old zone and diveQuestion's patch names question, answers, counts and set only, so openedAt and picks carry to the next question. The machine's pick row refuses only the same side (zone-machine.mjs:392), so a change would be accepted, but no window sends one: a reload resets pickOpenFor and still returns on the stored pick. sidesNow reads picks[actor.id] for a participant with no hall token. The handbook (gm-handbook.en.md:1596) promises the window and says a token holder who does not move keeps their zone, which matches a held pick but not the missing way to move. Minor fits: it needs a participant with no hall token.

checked.claim: A GM's Findings edit writes the whole list read earlier as an object patch, so a Finding a zone step adds in between is written over.
checked.why: addFinding, editFinding, deleteFinding and confirmFinding each read findingsNow() and hand writeFindings a whole list; writeFindings passes an object to setTrialProgress, which off the primary goes to recordOnPrimary('patch') and is spread over the record as the primary finds it (findings is in RECORD_FIELDS: RECORD_KEPT names chapter, mutedDead, objections and closing only), and on the primary queues on the same key. afterZoneStep adds a Finding by a function patch. The record's own comment says such a caller must pass the function. The window is narrow (one queue turn on the primary, one round trip off it), which keeps it minor.
